explanation: On S₄, u=0 and v decreases from 1 to 0. Thus x=v-1 and y=(v-1)²+1=x²+1, an upward-opening parabola traversed from (0,1) to (-1,2).

answers.correct_value: An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(0,1)$ to $(-1,2).$
answers.wrong_value: An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(-1,2)$ to $(0,1).$
